audience: developers and IT admins who manage domains and DNS records with DNSimple

useCases.title: List the domains in your account
useCases.text: The AI lists the domains in the account with their details. You get one overview and can open any domain by name or id.

useCases.title: Review all DNS records of a zone
useCases.text: The AI lists the records of a zone and filters them, for example to show only TXT or MX records and their content. You can check a setup in one answer.

useCases.title: Check if a domain can be registered and its prices
useCases.text: The AI checks if a domain can be registered and whether it is a premium name. It also reads the registration, renewal and transfer prices.

useCases.title: Add, change or delete a DNS record
useCases.text: The AI creates a new record in a zone, updates the content or TTL of one, or deletes one. These changes affect live DNS.

useCases.title: List the contacts used as domain registrants
useCases.text: The AI lists the contacts in the account that are used as registrants. You can check who is on record for your domains.
